message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of VERA’s workflow for assembling training sandboxes, generating binary rubrics, judging evidence, and synthesizing end-to-end or stage-wise environments.","description":"The diagram has three numbered sections. (1) “VERA Training Data Workflow”: a green-bordered “Verified Environments” box with a check mark, “Task Queries” with a question-mark icon, and “History Context” with a history/clock icon are joined by plus signs. A blue right-pointing arrow leads from these inputs to a green-bordered “Training Sandboxes” box marked with the Docker logo. To its right are the counts “x 4,567 CoWork” and “x 4,864 Med.” (2) “Automated Rubric Generation & Solid Agent Judge”: the “Auto Rubrics” panel contains three cards: Skill (“skill config & criteria”), Tool (“tool config & API docs”), and Trajectory (“agent config & exe. logs”). Each card shows “sub-rubrics,” binary {0, 1} entries, and an ellipsis. The adjacent “Agent Judge” panel has six checks in a two-column, three-row layout: Skill—“code,” “correct skill schema”; Tool—“code,” “correct tool schema”; Args—green “judge,” “parameters valid”; Effect—green “judge,” “action state verified”; Artifacts—green “judge,” “evidence claims”; and Context—green “judge,” “output quality check.” (3) “Environment Synthesis”: the “Benchmark Trajectories” box lists CoWork (terminal-bench, SWE-bench) and Med (AutoMedBench, MedXpertQA), above an “agent trajectories” strip. A green right-pointing arrow connects that strip to a panel headed “Auto Rubrics / Agent Judge.” In that panel a green plus precedes “Coding Agent”; a downward outlined arrow leads to the sequence “S1. plan — S2. setup — S3. verify — S4. execute — S5. submit.” Below, a green downward arrow from the trajectories area leads to “LLM Surrogate,” and a green downward arrow from the stage sequence leads to “Stage-Wise.” The lower green-tinted area shows an “End-to-End Env.” with a box labeled “end-to-end (excl. heavy execution)” and “80” beside it, a question-mark icon labeled “Queries,” and a row of stage query cards: S1 70, S2 81, S3 65, S4 90, S5 75. Green arrows connect the Queries icon leftward toward the end-to-end box and rightward toward the stage cards. The lower environments are labeled “End-to-End Env.” and “Stage-Wise Env.” At the bottom, green paths from both sides point inward to a check mark and “verify by Agent Judge.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
